title: Let Me See Thy Face and Die
lyrics_original: To Thee, great God of love! I bow,
And prostrate in Thy sight adore;
By faith I see Thee passing now;
I have, but still I ask for more,
A glimpse of love cannot suffice,
My soul for all Thy presence cries.
I cannot see Thy face, and live,
Then let me see Thy face, and die!
Moses Thy backward parts might view,
But not a perfect sight obtain;
The gospel doth Thy fulness show To us,
by the commandment slain;
The dead to sin shall find the grace
The pure in heart shall see Thy face.
I cannot see Thy face, and live, Then
let me see Thy face, and die!
Surrounded by the saints of old,
We now by faith approach
to Thee Shall all with open face behold
In Christ the glorious Deity;
Shall see, and put the Godhead on,
The nature of Thy sinless Son.
I cannot see Thy face, and live,
Then let me see Thy face, and die!

bible_verses.english: He said, “You cannot see my face, for no one can see my face and live.”
Then I will take away my hand, and you will see my back; but my face shall not be seen.”
When you said, “Seek my face,” my heart responded, “I will seek your face, Lord.”

devotional.prayer_english: Heavenly Father, my heart echoes the cry to know You more deeply and intimately today. Thank You that through Christ, the veil is torn and I am welcomed into Your holy presence. Forgive me for settling for mere glimpses of Your grace when You offer the fullness of Your love. Draw me near, Lord, and satisfy my longing soul with the light of Your face. Amen.

devotional.reflection_english: This song captures the holy restlessness of a heart that has tasted the love of God and simply cannot be satisfied with anything less than His full presence. While Moses could only catch a fleeting glimpse of God’s glory from the cleft of the rock, the Gospel invites us into direct intimacy through Jesus Christ. Today, let your soul echo this passionate desire, moving past surface-level devotion to seek the transformative beauty of the Father's face.
